capabilities: Apply per-note colors for page, pen, links, and accents
Add background patterns like grid, blueprint, and starfield to notes
Create and save reusable custom color palettes
Create themed notes and edit a note's theme from the ribbon or modal
Tint transparent-background images to match the note's pen color
extras: Themes stored as presets resolve colors at runtime, so updating a preset updates all notes using it; the plugin reads and writes its own frontmatter properties.
problem: Obsidian themes and CSS snippets apply vault-wide, so there is no easy way to give individual notes their own colors and background patterns without writing CSS.

relations.evidence: The image background removal feature is handled by Inkporter -> a fantastic plugin by AmadeussSystem.

summary: Per-note theming plugin that applies custom page, text, link, and accent colors plus built-in background patterns to individual notes.
